client_contract_changes.GeoSuggestItem: Gained optional `street?: string | null` and `municipality?: string | null` (mirrors backend SuggestItemDto(Label, Street?, Municipality?, Lat, Lng) — reconciled byte-for-byte against api/src/Taxi.Api/Features/Geo/Suggest/SuggestItemDto.cs). client_contract_changes.getGeoRoute: GET+query-string -> POST /geo/route with a NESTED JSON body { from:{lat,lng}, to:{lat,lng} }. The public getGeoRoute(req) signature stays FLAT (fromLat/fromLng/toLat/toLng) so NO consumer changed — the transform to the nested body happens inside the client fn at the boundary. Wire body verified at fetch level in client.test.ts. Mirrors backend RouteRequest/GeoPoint (api/src/Taxi.Api/Features/Geo/Route/{RouteRequest,GeoPoint}.cs); GeoPoint serializes camelCase {lat,lng}. Sidesteps the cs-CZ double query-binding locale trap (CLAUDE.md) that GET would have hit.
client_contract_changes.GeoRouteResponse: Gained optional `geometry?: number[][] | null` (simplified lat/lng polyline, max 200 points, null when unavailable — mirrors backend RouteResponse.Geometry IReadOnlyList<double[]>?). distanceMeters/durationSeconds/estimatedPriceCzk unchanged. Client parses geometry through (client.test.ts geometry-parse test); no drawing here (WI-17 owns drawing).

enriched_suggest_ui.shared_helper: web/src/shared/geo/suggestionMeta.ts — pure fn suggestionMeta(item): joins [street, municipality] with ' · ', trims whitespace-only parts, returns null when neither present. Promoted to shared/ because 3 features consume it (board OrderForm, orders OrderDrawer, customer AddressAutocomplete) per rules/web-architecture.md (no cross-feature imports; 2+ consumers => shared). 5 unit tests.
enriched_suggest_ui.accessibility_note: CRITICAL per advisor review: street+municipality is rendered as PLAIN TEXT inside the <li role="option"> (a span, NOT aria-hidden) so it is part of the option's ACCESSIBLE NAME. A screen-reader user hears the town and can tell Kolín from Kutná Hora (the substance of AC#2). Tests assert via getByRole('option', { name: /kolín/i }) — a decorative aria-hidden meta would pass axe + label-substring queries yet silently violate AC#2.
